speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe in detail the specific symptoms of your gait and limb ataxia, such as when they started and if they are progressive. Additionally, please list your significant medical history.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To better understand the progression, have you experienced any episodes of double vision, difficulty speaking, or numbness on the right side since your symptoms began? Also, could you please list your significant medical history?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy)

Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, the new onset of limb and gait ataxia is highly concerning for this opportunistic infection. I would like to confirm if you have noticed any subtle changes in your vision or hand coordination over the past few months. REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
